fact: The Supreme Council of Digital Society, formed under Presidential Decree No. 501 of 2022 and amended by No. 511, is chaired by the Prime Minister and approves the national strategy for building a fully digital state, with the Minister of Communications and Information Technology as rapporteur; the document is dated 2024 and gives no more precise date for the Council's formation than 2022.
